Lab: Select the Right Read and Remaining Budget

Which read is safe within the budget?

Three controls isolate a read leg. Lag zero represents proven minimum-version coverage, not actual clock-based freshness. Primary is assumed reachable; protected disclosure still needs current security/audit gates.
